## Organization

Scalixo Media is a digital marketing and growth agency based in Ahmedabad,
Gujarat, India. The agency builds brand systems, performance marketing
campaigns, content, and funnels for businesses across India and
internationally. Founded by Deep Thakkar.

- Website: https://scalixomedia.com/
- Phone: +91 93287 92160
- Email: scalixomedia@gmail.com
- Address: 301, 3rd Floor, Harvy Complex, Subhash Chowk, Gurukul Rd,
  Memnagar, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 380052, India
- Office hours: Monday to Saturday, 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM IST. Closed Sunday.
- Response time: Within 24 business hours.
- Founder: Deep Thakkar

## Contact page — FAQ

### How do I contact Scalixo Media?

You can reach Scalixo Media by phone at +91 93287 92160, by email at
scalixomedia@gmail.com, or by filling out the contact form at
https://scalixomedia.com/contact. We respond to all enquiries within 24
business hours.

### Where is Scalixo Media located?

Scalixo Media is based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Our office is at
301, 3rd Floor, Harvy Complex, Subhash Chowk, Gurukul Rd, Memnagar,
Ahmedabad 380052. You can view the exact location on Google Maps. We work
with clients across India and internationally.

### What are Scalixo Media's office hours?

Scalixo Media is open Monday to Saturday, 10:30 AM to 7:00 PM IST. We are
closed on Sundays. You can still send an enquiry via the form outside
business hours, and we will reply the next business day.

### Does Scalixo Media offer a free consultation?

Yes. Scalixo Media offers a free strategy call for new enquiries. Select
Free Strategy Call in the enquiry type field on the contact form and we
will schedule a 30-minute call to discuss your goals, timeline, and
current marketing setup.

### What services does Scalixo Media offer?

Scalixo Media offers performance marketing, social media marketing, SEO,
website design, brand strategy, and influencer marketing. You can explore
recent work at https://scalixomedia.com/portfolio or read about the
agency's approach at https://scalixomedia.com/about.
